paragraphs: As soon as Tang Biyue had calmed down, the two exchanged caresses for a few more minutes before finally getting up and getting dressed.

It wasn’t long before they found themselves descending an almost endless staircase.
The steps were made of stone, as were the walls and ceiling, seemingly carved on a gigantic solid rock.
After just over five minutes of walking, Biyue suddenly stopped her steps.
Her beautiful green eyes focused on an elderly man sitting next to an iron door.
"Greetings, divine physician." Biyue bowed respectfully, and Qingyi did the same, raising his gaze slightly.
A serene look, a long, well-kept beard, a small stature.
So that man was the divine doctor of the orthodox alliance, the most prestigious doctor in the entire nine peaks basin.
He was... ordinary.
He didn’t look much different from any other gentle old man.
"Oh... don’t be so polite, little Biyue, I still remember when you used to call me Grandpa... That was, what, 250 years ago? Those were good times..."
The divine doctor shook his head, his eyes lost in melancholy.
"235..." Biyue replied and the doctor’s eyes soon focused on Qingyi.
"I can see you’ve found a good man, your mother would certainly be proud, hahaha." The divine doctor gave an honest laugh as he approached, holding Qingyi’s shoulders firmly.
"Come, the patriarch of the Tang family is waiting for you." The old man led Qingyi to the iron door, opening it immediately and revealing the room inside.
It was little different from the corridors outside: solid stone, no decorations, just a few mana crystals and a bed.
Lying on that bed was a man whose body looked broken in a way that Qingyi had never seen in his life.
His eyes, green and beautiful like Biyue’s, were dull, empty, his skin covered in cracks, as if he was about to collapse in on himself.
Between these cracks, an intense venous aura leaked out unceasingly, illuminating everything around it with a sickly green.
The figure raised his hand slightly, his index finger crumbling into fragments of light before being slowly rebuilt.
’Just... how broken is this man’s body?’ Qingyi wondered.
Biyue’s father was one of the five most powerful transcendents on the continent, even considering the sect guardians.
How terrible did the demon cult leader’s power have to be to be able to do this to him?
"I believe you’re Qingyi, am I right?" A voice reached Qingyi’s ears.
Masculine, serene and soft. Strangely pleasant to the ears.
The handsome young man was sure it came from the man in front of him, but his mouth didn’t open, his eyes didn’t even turn.
"Don’t be alarmed, it’s just a kind of sound transmission, I’d rather not strain my body any further." The voice reached Qingyi once again.
Hesitating for a brief moment, Qingyi bowed. "Junior Long Qingyi greets father-in-law!"

"Father-in-law, huh? I never thought I’d be called anything like that, not by someone so young, least of all because of Biyue... that girl has always been so closed off." The patriarch spoke, his voice trembling softly.
With all the strength he had, he turned his face, horrible cracks echoing as his skin tore, even more of his aura leaking out.
"Come here... let me have a look at you."
Qingyi obeyed, kneeling beside the bed, his eyes fixed on those of the Tang patriarch.
"Biyue is a sweet and sensitive girl... you must have realized that by now... as the father of her, my most beloved child, I have a request to make of you."
"Go ahead, father-in-law, your son-in-law promises he’ll go to the ends of the earth to fulfill it." Qingyi declared.
He had expected many requests, except the one that came next.
"Don’t break her heart, not like I broke her mother’s... she doesn’t deserve that... Don’t die... Don’t disappear..."
An intense cough took hold of the Tang patriarch’s entire body, his eyes shuddering.
"Ah... looks like I won’t make it past today, hahaha." He laughed bitterly.
"I promise, father-in-law... I won’t break her heart." Qingyi declared.
He wasn’t sure if he could keep that promise; a woman’s heart was fragile after all.
But he still forced himself to try, even if it was only to calm the heart of a dying man.
He might have only known the Tang patriarch for a few minutes, but he already respected him as his father-in-law, his wife’s father.
How could Qingyi not feel his heart tremble at seeing him like that?
"I’m glad she chose such a good man..." A bitter smile appeared on the Tang patriarch’s face, his eyes closing briefly.
The steel door opened again, and the divine doctor entered.
"He just needs some time to rest..." The doctor shook his head after checking the patriarch’s pulse.
Qingyi and Biyue thanked the doctor before leaving, their eyes focused on the horizon.
A few hours after that meeting, the Tang patriarch’s soul collapsed completely, taken back to the wheel of reincarnation, where his life of honor, kindness and glory would define his next birth.
Biyue cried like a motherless child, soaking the robes of Qingyi, who just hugged her all night, giving his all to console her.
Despite this, no one knew about the death.
Quite the opposite, in fact.
In the minds of most of the warriors of the orthodox alliance, the patriarch was healing well and would soon be back at his peak, the truth being kept under lock and key by the council of elders.
Nobody needed to know about the death of the Tang family patriarch, not yet.
It could seriously affect the morale of their troops.
They needed to create a scenario of peace and prosperity, using the battle between Qingyi and Tianyu to boost morale even further before giving the order to march.
It was just the way politics worked.

The husband should be joining us shortly." Elize smiled and, after waiting for Qingyi, watched as they devoured the food she had prepared with so much love.
Not even the most esteemed chefs in the Nine Peaks Basin could compare to her in the kitchen.
Far from the orthodox alliance and deep in the deadlands, the leader of the demon cult was on his knees, praying.
He was in a small temple and in front of him was a miniature statue of a being similar to the one his son had turned into before being killed by Qingyi.
The celestial demon.
Not the title he bore as the leader of the demon cult, but the real celestial demon, the one who inhabits the celestial heaven itself and who will one day cleanse these unholy lands.
"May the celestial demon bless us and may our victory be eternal," Mochen whispered, standing up.
In the distance, he heard light, patient footsteps approaching him, opening the temple door.
It was the demon doctor.
"I'm sorry, little Mochen," the old man said, walking over to Mochen.
He hadn't said what had happened, it wasn't necessary.
It was plain on the old man's face: the chief strategist of the demon cult had succumbed to his injuries.
Mochen closed his eyes, inhaling deeply, calming his mind.
With a wave of his hands, a member of the Crimson Guard, Mochen's personal protector, appeared in front of him, kneeling down.
This man was not just an ordinary crimson guard; holding the position of captain of the guard, one of Mochen's most trusted men.
"What did intelligence find?" Mochen asked.
"We found no indication that the Orthodox alliance was responsible for ambushing the great strategist, my lord.
The seventh palace seems to have been responsible," the guard declared.
Mochen thought for a moment, pondering what to do next.
"Give the extermination order," Mochen declared coldly.
"Not even a single one of them must escape."
"Yes, my lord." The crimson guard bowed before, with one smooth movement, disappearing into thin air.
Mochen's eyes were cold as he walked past the demon doctor, leaving the temple.
Outside, a single elder was waiting for him.
The elder of the demon cult's war pavilion.
"Gather all the disciples, we'll be marching under the heretics soon."

chapters.title: Chapter 259 - FACE ME LIKE A MAN!
paragraphs: "Young Miss Biyue, are you excited for today's duel?" An ancient voice called out to Biyue.
The owner of that voice was a kindly-looking old woman with gray hair, her body comically small for the chair she used.
She was the leader of the Ice Flower Sect, one of the nine great sects of the Nine Peaks Basin.

They were now in the arena of the Orthodox Alliance, in a luxurious cabin reserved for only the most distinguished guests: The leaders and guardians of the 9 great sects and 7 great families, the council elders and the battalion leaders.
Their eyes filtered the arena below them, surrounded by stands where the voices of over a hundred thousand cultivators exploded in animated conversation.
The duel between Qingyi and Tianyu, a rookie of incomparable talent and the commander of the most powerful battalion in the orthodox alliance.
How could they not be excited?
"Yes," Biyue nodded at the old woman's question, settling into her chair.
"That Qingyi boy is truly exceptional, a pity he had to face our Tianyu in a duel to the death."
A man with a dignified face and golden eyes spoke, turning his face towards a huge flaming tiger while stroking his short goatee.
"It will be a great loss for the Eternal River Sect..."
Yanxiao merely grunted angrily in response, ignoring those words.
That man was the leader of the Ancestral Dragon Sect, one of the most mysterious of the nine great sects, said by many to be the most powerful, but which kept much of its power hidden.
It wasn't long before a loud bell sounded.
On the horizon, a figure in wide robes appeared, flying into the center of the arena.
The moment this figure raised a hand, the entire arena fell silent.
"Long Tianyu" The figure called out and in the distance, a tall, handsome man appeared, the powerful muscles of his body almost bursting through his robes.
His face bore an arrogant smile, his huge sword glowing with a golden Qi, similar to his eyes.
Turning his face away, the figure called out again. "Long Qingyi."
Responding to this call, a young man appeared; long black hair, piercing eyes and a face of such profound beauty that it didn't even look human.

Soon, the two of them arrived at the center of that arena's large stone platform, stretching for almost two kilometers from one end to the other, surrounded by spiritual arrays powerful enough to hold off the attacks of Rebirth realm cultivators.
"This is a duel to the death, initiated by Long Tianyu and accepted by Long Qingyi, the battle will last until death or surrender followed by mercy.
The use of any forbidden technique or external artifact will result in the immediate interruption of the duel. Do you both understand?"
"Yes, elder." They declared in unison.
"Good." The figure smiled as he flew into the sky. "Fight with honor and glory."
The moment the figure's voice ceased, they both advanced at the same time.
The heaven-defying thunder sword hissed as it slid out of its sheath, surrounded by a thunderous lightning aura, meeting Tianyu's weapon.
A bang took over the entire arena, the flags of the orthodox alliance fluttering as the shockwave spread.
"You arrogant son of a bitch!" Tianyu roared, being forced backwards.
That had only been an exploratory exchange of blows, to find out each other's power, but it still caused great shock to all the spectators.
Tianyu, from the peak of the Rebirth realm, had been forced to take three steps backwards while Qingyi, from the second stage of the Rebirth realm, had only taken a single step backwards.
Even though Qingyi's talent and lineage was one of the most powerful in the history of the nine peaks basin, he still shouldn't have overcome all that difference in cultivation.
Especially against Tianyu, who also had a powerful draconic lineage.
"Watch your tongue, senior, I don't want to have to rip it out." Qingyi replied, his voice tinged with a few drops of poison.
"You don't have the power to." Tianyu readied his weapon, glancing at Biyue out of the corner of his eye.
She was watching the battle with far more interest than anyone else there, but her eyes were only focused on Qingyi, as if he was everything to her.
Tianyu's face sank into jealousy and he gritted his teeth hard enough for his gums to bleed.
"You'll regret setting your eyes on a phoenix while you're just a toad, but don't worry, a worthy heir will take that phoenix, over your dead body!" Tianyu roared, his body changing.

Ethereal, golden horns appeared above his head, accompanied by the enormous figure of a white dragon that seemed to follow the swing of his sword, tearing up everything in front of it as it flowed towards Qingyi.
Qingyi had to treat that attack more seriously, his eyes filled with a purple glow as he used the third form of the Storm Monarch's sword art.

The heaven-defying thunder sword struck Tianyu's, the power of this attack powerful enough for the spiritual arrays protecting the arena to fail briefly, the ground beneath their feet sinking into a crater.
Tianyu tried to push even harder, struggling to push Qingyi back, even by a single step.
But it didn't happen, Qingyi stood firm like a wall of steel.
Even when the white dragon behind Tianyu roared, even when all the Qi of his bloodline was forced into just that one projection, Qingyi's power simply wasn't affected.
It didn't diminish in the slightest.
Of course, the spectators noticed all this, the impressed murmurs about Qingyi's power reaching Tianyu's ears.
They were despising him, even with all his strength, unable to break through the power of a junior of much lower cultivation than him and who was clearly holding back.
The leader of the dragon battalion, the strongest of the battalions in the orthodox alliance; what a joke.
"DISGRACEFUL BASTARD!"
Tianyu roared, finally gathering enough strength to throw Qingyi backwards, overcome by rage.
"USE ALL YOUR POWER, CALL ON YOUR LINEAGE! FACE ME LIKE A MAN!"
Qingyi remained silent for long seconds, a gentle smile spreading across his handsome face.
"My lineage is not to please the ego of any arrogant insect." He declared.

chapters.title: Chapter 260 - Was it worth it?
paragraphs: There were many kinds of dragons.
Some were kind, others evil; some barely cared about those below them while others cared too much.
But there was one thing that united all dragons: their arrogance and ego.
Even the gentlest of dragons had the arrogance to defy the heavens and the ego to think themselves above them.
How could Qingyi's words not affect Tianyu? A man with a draconic bloodline, overcome with jealousy and with an ego as fragile as butterfly wings?
"You..." Tianyu growled, his voice more like the grunt of a beast.
Above him, the figure of the white dragon grew even larger, its serpentine body flying over the arena, stretching for more than two hundred meters, a golden light bathing everything below it.
One of the transcendents watching acted quickly, moving his Qi around the arena and protecting the weaker spectators.
"You'll pay for those words!" Tianyu pointed his sword at Qingyi. The Qi surrounding him fell to the ground like molten gold, spreading out around his feet.
'No weaker than Biyue before I helped her evolve her bloodline and constitution to mortal grade...' Qingyi thought, readying his blade and watching Tianyu.
Whatever he was planning, it was powerful, but Qingyi didn't bother to stop it.
After almost ten seconds, an eternity for cultivators of that level, the golden Qi finally stopped falling to the ground, forming a lake of gold that stretched for twenty meters around Tianyu.
"This is the secret technique I inherited from my master. I'll give you one last chance, take this battle seriously! Die with some honor!" Tianyu declared.
"I'm treating this battle as seriously as it deserves."
The moment Qingyi's voice fell silent, the world around Tianyu changed.
The golden lake beneath his feet shuddered, moving gently before turning into a violent whirlpool, swirling around Tianyu and swallowing him up completely.
The golden Qi surrounding him shone more brightly than ever, blinding many of the spectators as the whirlpool expanded further and further.
It wasn't long before the formations protecting the arena began to fail, the ground beneath Tianyu's feet sinking as everything within a radius of hundreds of meters around him collapsed.
Only the part where the audience stood remained intact, protected by the power of the transcendents.
"DIE!" Tianyu's roar echoed as he advanced towards Qingyi.
The handsome young man reacted immediately. Sixteen blades of lightning appeared around him, flying towards Tianyu and breaking the sound barrier, accompanied by the heaven-defying sword of thunder.
The golden whirlpool covered Tianyu completely, but with his draconic eyes, Qingyi had little difficulty in perceiving Tianyu's movements, even with the absurd density of Qi in front of him.

Covering himself with black scales, Qingyi broke through the golden whirlpool, his sword hitting Tianyu's, the other sixteen swords stopping a few centimeters before they were able to pierce his body from all sides.
With the exception of the power of his lineage projection, Qingyi didn't hold back, putting all his strength into that clash.
The thunderous rays of his lightning sword Qi joined with the golden Qi, destroying everything around.
With both the sides and the top of the arena completely blocked by the transcendents' Qi, there was only one place where all that power could go: down.
The stone beneath both their feet turned to dust, their bodies sinking into an ever-deeper crater.
"You've got a good sword there. I think it'll be a good test." Qingyi flashed a big smile, his calm, serene eyes focused on Tianyu's, terribly distorted in hatred and frustration.

Without hesitation, Qingyi moved his sword Qi, forming an even sharper edge in front of the heaven-defying thunder sword, tenuously using his fire Qi with his lightning Qi to raise the temperature as much as possible.
It was time to finally test the heaven-defying thunder sword's new power after its breakthrough to mortal grade.
"Impossible!" The leader of the ancestral dragon sect suddenly stood up, his eyes wide open.
The sword Tianyu was using was a personal gift from him, a mortal grade item and one of his sect's most powerful treasures.
How great was the horror that gripped his face as Qingyi's sword sank into Tianyu's?
Suddenly, the Qi of both of them stopped, the thunderous clashes of their auras being replaced by a strange silence.
A metallic clang echoed as the melted tip of Tianyu's sword fell to the stone floor below them, who now found themselves in a crater more than two hundred meters deep.
Tianyu looked at his own sword, or at least what was left of it in his hand.
Tears of hatred streamed down his cheeks and he fell to his knees, a terrible gash tearing through his chest.
"Ah..." Qingyi sighed, gently turning his face.
Among so many shocked looks was Biyue, her rosy lips curved into a suppressed smile, her pale cheeks blushing softly.
"B-bastard - Blergh!" Tianyu vomited a large gulp of blood, being forced to move his hands to the ground, trying not to collapse.
"Was it worth it?" Qingyi asked, pressing his blade against Tianyu's neck, a little disappointed.
"Truly a waste of talent on such a disgusting, insignificant insect..." Qingyi retracted the heaven-defying thunder sword before swinging it with full force.
An explosion of blood stained the ground behind Tianyu, his head being thrown into the air.
Qingyi closed his eyes briefly, calming his breathing.
Fighting Tianyu without using his lineage projection was difficult.
If Tianyu had been just a little less arrogant, he would probably have managed to at least injure Qingyi.
Unfortunately for him, he was too blind.
Qingyi's body floated above the crater, his victory finally being announced, with tens of thousands of spectators shouting his name.
Almost all of them except those from the dragon battalion, of course.
Their battalion leader had just died, defeated in a miserable fight in which his opponent of lesser cultivation didn't even take him seriously.
How could they be happy about that?
It was impossible, their heads were down and their eyes were shaking.

chapters.title: Chapter 261 - Don't worry, two months is more than enough!
paragraphs: The effect of the duel between Qingyi and Tianyu was immediate, the morale of the alliance troops exploding.
It wasn't every day that they got to see battles at such a high level, and the fact that the alliance risked such great talents demonstrated their strength and confidence to the masses.
Of course, such an explosion of morale didn't spread to the leadership.
No one was happy about Tianyu's death, but there wasn't much they could do.
Tianyu made his choice and paid the consequences.
Now, what they really needed to do was discuss their defence strategy.
"Do you really think it's a good idea to divide our forces?" Biyue asked, looking anxiously at the large map of the Nine Peaks Basin in front of her.
"No," the leader of the divine sword sect said, shaking his head.
"But the moment the demonic army starts moving, the demonic Qi in the dead lands will go crazy, hiding them completely. We won't know where they're going until it's too late."
Running his fingers over the map, he marked the most rough areas of the border with the deadlands; simple for a few soldiers to pass through, but completely unfeasible for a full army.
In the end, the demonic cult could only follow two paths.
One was the forest of the fallen moon, a peaceful and isolated region with difficult terrain, but which could be passed easily.
The other was the gorge of the dragon blade, in the northernmost part of the border with the deadlands.
Being closest to the demon cult, it was the most likely route, especially considering all the logistical problems the demon cult faced.
The plan was simple: the main army would take care of guarding the gorge of the dragon's blade, while the reserve army would defend the forest of the fallen moon.
If they chose to take the longer route, all the reserve army had to do was hold out until the arrival of the Transcendents, who would have no trouble defending themselves until the main army arrived.
"Everything looks good, I'm confident we can muster six hundred thousand soldiers above the Burning Blood Realm for the main army easily. That should be enough to deal with the demon cult.

But what about the reserve army? We lack a lot of manpower and the snake battalion is the only one to lead the reserve, they won't even have the support of any transcendents," one of the council elders spoke up.

"I can muster no more than twelve thousand combat-ready cultivators," Biyue tapped a finger under the table, calculating her strength. "The rest of my battalion are cultivators of non-combat position, it's difficult for them to fight."
"We can draw from our own disciples for the reserve army, another fifty thousand should be enough,"
It was Yanxiao who replied, his huge flaming body making the air in the room rise in temperature, his feline face watching everyone there coldly.
"As for not having any transcendents with them, that's not a problem.
Qingyi can hold his own against weaker transcendents and the demon cult leader himself won't interfere against someone like him, he's too proud for that."
If Ruyan had been in that room, she would probably have laughed at how little those people knew her father.
But she wasn't, so they could only follow the advice of Yanxiao and the other guardian beasts.
They were much older than everyone else and had fought the demon cult before.
The powerful experts were ready to move on to the next topic when a loud knock echoed at the door, an elder entering the meeting room.
His face bore a stern apprehension and his steps were a little shaky.
Naturally, such a sight brought concern to everyone there.
That elder was at the peak of the rebirth realm, nothing minor would leave him like that.
"We've received the latest report from our spies in the demon cult."

"Their grand strategist has died and the leader of the demon cult is out of his mind, ordering the gathering of an army of two million demonic cultivators, even forcing leaders of other unorthodox factions to join him.
Those words silenced the entire meeting room.
Two million cultivators... they could gather such a number, but only if they left their sects and families seriously unprotected and called for help from smaller sects.
For the leader of the demon cult to make such a bet... was he crazy?
"Is this information confirmed?" asked the patriarch of the Zhao Family, one of the representatives of the seven great families.
"Yes. It comes from a spy planted with the great elder of the demonic cult.

Other spies planted with powerful figures have confirmed similar information, the numbers varying between 1.5 and 2 million soldiers gathered from almost all the unorthodox sects and families that inhabit the dead lands."
The powerful experts in that room listened to those words, still incredulous.
"If that's true, we need to issue the general convocation order as soon as possible," someone finally declared, receiving nods of affirmation from everyone there.

A general convocation order was basically a call for all cultivators above a certain cultivation level, a measure created during the last demon war, where armies of tens of millions of cultivators faced each other.
In the current state of the orthodox alliance, that was the only way they could gather so many cultivators at high enough levels to be useful in combat.
When the meeting ended, everyone left the room with worried faces, especially Biyue, who immediately went after Qingyi.
Finding him in her residence, she threw herself on him, hugging him tightly.
"What's wrong, is everything all right?" Qingyi asked, Biyue just nodded.
"We'll be marching out to face the demon cult soon, we don't have more than a month or two to prepare," Biyue muttered. "I'm just worried that it might not be enough time."
"Two months... I didn't expect them to be so kind to us, hahaha," Qingyi laughed.
"Don't worry, two months is more than enough for me to get strong enough to get rid of that demon cult leader."

It was a small, golden ring, adorned with a single, elegant jade stone at the top.
For the price and functionality, it was cheap.
Closing his eyes, Qingyi entered the world of Ruxue's mind, immediately gathering the girls together and handing them each a ring.
Naturally, they were all extremely happy; it wasn't every day that their husband gave them presents, especially such expensive ones.
In total, he had spent 7.5 million lust points on 30 void veil rings, a considerable sum, but nothing compared to their security.
After having lunch with them, Qingyi finally returned to the outside world.
He was at Biyue's residence, more specifically, in her personal cultivation room.
With a soft sigh, he stood up, every muscle in his body tensing as he felt his own power.
All those breakthroughs had brought him to a level where he could proudly declare: there was no enemy under mortal heaven that he dared not challenge.
Suddenly, a slight tremor ran through Qingyi's body and he walked to the balcony of the residence.
Raising his head, he looked up at the sky, his heartbeat accelerating.
Qingyi was feeling strange. Something in his chest, a line; thin, subtle, almost imperceptible, but it was there, rising up to the heavens, touching them.
He had heard stories in ancient books of the heavens above mortals.

In those places, the primordial laws were so powerful that a name could make the world tremble, that every challenge to the heavens was answered immediately; provided, of course, that the heavens deemed the challenger worthy.
That was also the reason why transcendents were the only ones who could ascend to mortal heaven.
As well as having a law of their own, capable of modifying the primordial laws around them, transcendents also formed a connection with the heavens.
It was from this connection that they could challenge the heavens and, if they won, they could ascend.
Qingyi already feeling this connection only made it clear how powerful he truly already was.
Turning around, he got dressed, taking one last look at the horizon before heading down to the lower levels of the snake battalion's administrative pavilion.

Things were chaotic down there, people running around, piles of documents piling up on the desks of the attendants who were desperately trying to register all the new warriors who would be under the snake battalion in the next war.
Qingyi ignored all this, happy that it wasn't his problem.
Stepping outside, he turned his face towards the great wall on the horizon, his eyes focusing on the figure of a woman under one of the many towers that protected it.
Her beautiful green eyes watched the sun set over the horizon, her long black hair dancing in the gentle breeze.
With a gentle push, he flew towards her, his face showing a big smile as he hugged her from behind.

chapters.title: Chapter 265 - When will I be able to live with the girls full-time?
paragraphs: "Attention!" Biyue shouted, her sweet, soft voice echoing for kilometers.
In front of her were two rows, totaling 200 cultivators, all of the Rebirth realm.
Just behind these rows were countless others, thousands, tens of thousands of cultivators, none weaker than the Burning Blood Realm.
It was impossible to deny that the sight of so many cultivators lined up like that was indeed threatening.
But that was just the reserve army, created to defend the forest of the fallen moon.
It was incomparable to the main army which, after all the processing of recruits, had reached more than 1.8 million soldiers.
Of course, transporting them all in flying ships was almost impossible, even though the Orthodox alliance had more than fifteen huge arks, capable of carrying tens of thousands of soldiers each.
As a result, only the 400,000 strongest were transported by the chests, the rest being forced to make their way on foot.

Fortunately, Biyue had obtained permission from her family's grand elder to use the Tang family's two largest transport ships; colossi capable of carrying more than twenty-five thousand cultivators each.
More than enough to transport the entire reserve army.
"That's..." One of the recruits looked up, his eyes widening as a huge bell sounded.
Above them, two wooden behemoths tore through the sky, stretching for more than a kilometer from stern to bow, large flags rising above.
"The Tang family's flying ships!" Another exclaimed, recognizing the emblem the ships bore on their sides.
"The Tang family will take care of the transportation. Enter slowly and orderly, the servants will show you where you'll be lodged," Biyue said, receiving only silent nods.
Even though flying ships were common in the Nine Peaks Basin, traveling in them was still rare for most ordinary cultivators.
Something as large and luxurious as the two largest ships of the wealthy Tang family was something most people would never have expected to be able to experience in their life.
Soon, the ships descended to the ground, large double doors opening, a huge wooden ramp slowly descending, offering a platform to enter the ship.
Forming an organized queue, boarding began smoothly.
"Monitor everything," Biyue ordered the two hundred Rebirth Realm cultivators below her, flying to one of the ships.
Obviously, her cabin was completely separate, being in a wing of its own, designated only for high-ranking members of the Tang family.
"Qingyi..." She called out as she entered her cabin, her beautiful green eyes focusing on a young man lying on her luxurious bed.
"Oh... finally remembered your husband?" He smiled, watching Biyue approach.
"You know I don't..." She murmured, letting her voluptuous body fall over Qingyi, her huge breasts pressing against him.
"I haven't slept for over a month... I just want some peace, away from that administrative chaos." She snuggled into Qingyi's chest. "When will I be able to live with the girls full-time?"
"Any time you want. You can drop everything right now, leave the problem to someone else and just relax," Qingyi replied, drawing a giggle from Biyue.
"I can't abandon everything, you know that. If the demon cult wins..." Biyue closed her eyes, barely able to imagine a world in which this would happen.
Even if she wasn't here to see it, even if she ascended alongside Qingyi.
She still didn't want to accept such a world.
"You're right," Qingyi said, giving her a kiss on the forehead. "Get some sleep. The journey will take some days, right? It should be enough for you to rest well."
Hearing Qingyi's words, Biyue just did her best to push the worries out of her heart, falling asleep as she felt Qingyi stroke her hair.
Seven days passed in the blink of an eye.
The main army quickly organized itself in front of the Dragon's Blade Gorge, forming a defensive line that stretched for kilometers.
"Still no information about the demon cult's movements?" The leader of the divine sword sect asked, his eyes watching the deadlands with contempt.
The demonic Qi was going mad and their senses could barely penetrate a few meters into that cursed region.
They were now in the main army camp, more than 1 million cultivators covering the ground beneath them.
Others 800,000 were yet to arrive, but no one there was worried.
That 1 million was more than enough, at least in the short term, without considering the chances of a long war.
"No," an elder shook his head. "We haven't received any more reports from the spies. All we know is that their army is already marching towards our borders."
"Crap..." The leader of the Divine Sword Sect spat, looking at his fellow Transcendents.
He was about to say something when a small pulse of mana appeared between his robes, drawing his attention.
That pulse came from a talisman that linked the main army to the reserve army, an item capable of sending messages for hundreds of kilometers.
"What happened? Did the reserve army have a problem?" Yanxiao asked, looking at the small talisman in the hands of the leader of the divine sword sect.
He didn't answer Yanxiao, or even the leaders of the other sects, just raising his head, looking at the horizon.
"Can you feel what I feel?" he asked, closing his eyes.
The other transcendents looked at him as if he were mad, but that didn't last long. Their eyes widened as they focused on the dead land.
The ground shook, a cloud of dust rising on the horizon. Horrific roars echoed as auras reaching even the realm of transcendence exploded.
"A horde of spirit beasts..." everyone muttered at the same time, unable to believe their own eyes as they quickly calculated the numbers.
Even with the extremely fast minds of transcendents, they needed almost a minute.
There were easily more than five hundred thousand beasts there, all seized by demonic Qi, rushing madly towards them.
"Should we send reinforcements to the reserve army?" A question echoed out, but no answer was needed.
Such a large horde of beasts was probably made up of almost all the powerful spirit beasts in the dead lands.
This was something even more dangerous than the demon cult's main army; they had to fight.

chapters.title: Chapter 266 - We have our own battle.
paragraphs: There was a reason why no cultivators below the Burning Blood Realm were used in wars in the Nine Peaks Basin: they were useless.
In reality, even those of the Burning Blood realm were little more than cannon fodder, with only the Crystalline Core realm cultivators being considered useful, regular soldiers.
Their main use was basically to hold the back lines of those above the Nascent Soul Realm, dealing with weakened enemies and forming the bulky part of the army.
Of course, when the battlefield involved Rebirth realm cultivators, things changed dramatically.
Even those of the crystalline core realm were not safe.
"You're too compacted! Split up!" The voice of the leader of the Ice Flower Sect echoed over the battlefield.
Her small, frail body tore through the air at absurd speed, landing on the ground with a thud.
Her wrinkled face contorted as she pressed both palms against the ground.
A translucent barrier of pure ice rose up in front of her, rising hundreds of meters before curving like a frozen wave towards the advancing horde.
With a single wave of her hand, that colossal wall collapsed.
The ice melted instantly, turning into a tsunami that swallowed up the vanguard of demonic beasts - only to freeze again in the next instant, trapping hundreds of them.
That was her law: the ability to instantly change the physical states of water.
Unfortunately, that wasn't enough.
The rest of the horde simply leapt over the frozen corpses, their crazed demonic Qi colliding violently with the Qi of the orthodox cultivators above the Rebirth Realm.
The initial impact was devastating.
Anyone below the Nascent Soul Realm who hadn't already retreated was instantly torn apart by the shockwave, blood and guts painting the ground red.
The Gorge of the Dragon Blade was about ten kilometers wide at its widest point. Yet there wasn't a single centimeter of it that wasn't filled with absolute chaos.
The Rebirth Realm cultivators soon took the fighting to the skies. Great pulses of energy swept through everything for hundreds of meters, making the space below shake violently.
"They can take care of themselves. We have our own battle." Yanxiao roared, his flaming eyes following the gaze of the other Transcendents.
In the distance, watching them coldly, they could see Transcendence realm demonic beasts, dozens of them.
False dragons, tigers, giant tortoises and many others... Beings whose bodies reached hundreds of meters in length, exuding a sickly demonic Qi that spread like plague for kilometers.
Those were probably all the spirit beasts from that realm in the Deadlands.
How on earth had the Demon Cult managed to gather so many? Had they used some kind of profane formation? Mass sacrifices?
The answer, honestly, didn't matter anymore.
Below them, the battle had already turned into endless carnage as the tide lines of beasts collided with the human cultivators.
If those transcendent beasts got close too... the casualties would be incalculable.
Exchanging glances, they advanced, all at the same time, each focusing on a beast.
Yanxiao was one of the first, right next to the leader of the Zhao family and the ice tigress, guardian of the ice flower sect and lover of the flaming tiger.
His huge jaw opened, revealing fangs the size of daggers.
The depths of his throat lit up with a deep orange light as a thin thread of Qi gathered on the tip of his tongue.
This filament spun on itself, condensing into a sphere not much bigger than a soccer ball - but burning hot enough to melt steel instantly.
Taking careful aim, Yanxiao fired.
His body weighed over two tons and he was flying at top speed, breaking the sound barrier, but he was still thrown backwards by the power of the shot.
His target was the beast in the center, a demonic winged serpent, the weakest of them all.
The snake tried desperately to dodge, its huge wings flapping with enough force to create gale force winds.
Unfortunately for it, its body was too big and heavy for quick dodges.
Yanxiao's attack hit its head with an explosion that incinerated everything within a radius of kilometers.
The heat melted its reddish scales right into its flesh. Its mouth opened in a high-pitched, desperate hiss.
Yanxiao didn't stop.
His body grew to a size no smaller than the snake's and his fangs sank into the creature's exposed throat.
For the first time in millennia of peace, he tasted blood in a real battle - disgusting, repulsive demon blood, but blood nonetheless.
Applying pressure, he felt the once-resistant scales break, his claws tearing through flesh as he stopped the serpent from coiling around his neck.
He only stopped when his teeth met and the decapitated body fell to the ground with a thud, bathing the ground below in blood.
The moment Yanxiao finished his fight, dozens of auras exploded around him.
The skies were painted with different types of Qi, destruction taking over as far as the eye could see.
Suddenly, the fight between thousands of cultivators and beasts of the rebirth realm seemed like a mere competition between ants, their auras severely suppressed by the battles between transcendents.

In the midst of this chaos, a chubby figure carrying illusory Qi moved: a former member of the snake battalion who had recently left the orthodox alliance, just in time to be enlisted in the main army by his sect.
Honestly, he had already regretted that decision.
To hell with seeing things he shouldn't have, things that might make Qingyi want to slit his throat - anything was better than fighting those beasts.
"Be careful, you useless fatso!"
A bang echoed as a burly warrior positioned himself in front of Heidu, raising his huge sword and blocking a demonic horned wolf
"S-shit, I'm sorry!" Heidu shouted, regaining his composure.
He pointed both trembling hands towards the bloodthirsty eyes of the beast, whose teeth were driven deep into the warrior's blade.
A burst of light followed, blinding the beast temporarily, just long enough for the warrior to cut off its head.
Heidu breathed a sigh of relief, retreating even further to the rear.
This life was not for him.
If only he had a way of retiring with great wealth, if he had enough merit for it.
Unfortunately, he wasn't at that level yet. Not without providing information of inestimable importance to the Orthodox Alliance.
He had such information, yes. But... should he share it?

chapters.title: Chapter 267 - Now it's my turn, right?
paragraphs: There was a reason why the forest of the fallen moon had that name - two, to be precise.
The first was that it was in a dark region, surrounded by mountains that hid it from the sun for almost the entire year.
Its only form of illumination was a huge rounded stone, floating a few thousand meters off the ground, surrounded by crystals of Qi that shone brightly.
That was the second reason: Similar to a fallen moon, illuminating a forest that spread for thousands of kilometers.
Against this scenary, the Tang family's gigantic flying ships tore through the sky, stopping just a few kilometers from the valley that connected the forest of the fallen moon to the dead lands.
"When will the landing begin?" Qingyi asked, hugging Biyue from behind, his groin pressing against her plump, juicy ass while his hands went up to her bountiful breasts, squeezing them tightly.

"Nghnn~~ right now... the flying ships have to get back to the family as soon as possible..." Biyue gasped, melting into Qingyi's embrace, her beautiful green eyes focused on the forest ahead, bathed in soft false moonlight.
After a moment of silence, she spoke: "My older brother used to bring me here when I was a child. It was dangerous, but he always managed to convince his father."
"Hm..." Qingyi followed her gaze, fixated on the false moon that hung above everything. "Have you ever been to that place?"
"No..." She shook her head. "Yandu always said it was too dangerous for a child."
"Well, it's a good thing you're not a child anymore, isn't it?" Qingyi flashed a mischievous smile and a smack echoed as his hand sank into Biyue's plump, shapely, bubble butt, squeezing hard.
She blushed intensely, shuddering for a brief moment before nodding.
Indeed, she was no longer a child.
"Then let's go. Your officers can take care of the rest." Qingyi said.
Without even waiting for Biyue to reply, he jumped out of the cabin window, flying towards the false moon that illuminated the forest with its elegant bluish light.
Biyue hesitated for a brief moment before sighing and following right behind him.
It wasn't long before she realized why her older brother was so hesitant to take her there.
The density of Qi was increasing more and more, becoming increasingly violent.
Of course, far from causing damage to a body like hers, but still capable of easily tearing a mortal apart.
Qingyi landed on top of the false moon, closing his eyes softly, feeling the pure breeze sweep through his hair.

That was something he genuinely appreciated about that world: as long as he wasn't directly in demon territory, the air was pure, free of any trace of the industrial pollution of the world he used to live in.
Feeling Biyue land gracefully beside him, he wrapped his arms around her thin, delicate waist, pulling her against his chest.
Immediately afterwards, the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword shone brightly, dozens of female figures of transcendental beauty materializing around them.
"Oh... so beautiful!" Elize exclaimed as she held up her small, delicate hands, trying to capture the luminous fragments that broke off at every step on that false moon.
From the forest below to the great mountains that rose up around it, everything was bathed in a veil of ethereal, bluish light.
Everything there was beautiful
"Ah... I almost forgot!" Qingyi suddenly remembered something, taking the last protective ring he had bought and putting it on Biyue's finger.
"Is that...?" She covered her mouth, unable to believe her eyes.
Of course, it didn't take her long to realize that all the other girls wore the same kind of ring - but what did it matter?
This was her ring. Hers and no one else's.
She was about to reply when she saw Qingyi's expression change dramatically.
His eyes glowed a deep purple as he abruptly turned around.
"Biyue, call the main army..." He ordered, his voice losing all warmth as he gripped the Heaven-Defying Sword tightly.
In the distance, he saw the thin film separating the demonic Qi of the Deadlands from the pure Qi of the Forest of the Falling Moon shatter.
Biyue seemed confused by that request, but that confusion was soon swept from her body. Her trembling hands immediately grabbed the token and activated it.
An intense crimson light suddenly exploded on the horizon, ripping through tens of kilometers in the blink of an eye and hitting one of the flying ships perched on the ground - splitting it in half.
Heartbreaking screams echoed as the weakest were torn apart. Only those above the crystalline core realm could barely withstand the pressure of that attack.
At that moment, Biyue noticed.
A man was floating gently in the air, watching them with disdain.
His face was dignified and cruel, a pair of broken black horns rising from between his night-black hair. Its blood-red eyes swept over everyone present, focusing mainly on Ruyan.
"Father..." Ruyan was barely able to utter before she felt Biyue's Qi explode beside her.
"Wait!" Qingyi roared, trying to grab Biyue - but it was too late.
The poisonous beauty broke through the skies, her eyes blazing with a crazed rage as the dying figure of her father appeared in her mind.
She couldn't control herself in the slightest. Her body poured out a cloud of cruel poison, causing the forest below to wither and die, trees melting in on themselves.
Above her, a gigantic serpent with crystalline scales appeared out of nowhere, stretching for hundreds of meters, its mouth leaking a poison even more lethal than the one released by Biyue.
This entire cloud of poison converged into a single point in the shape of a blade, flowing towards the demon cult leader's heart.
He didn't defend himself, nor did he think it necessary, just opening his hands, accepting Biyue's attack.
The moment this attack hit him, it was as if the world had lost all color other than the green of Biyue's poison, flowing towards the demon cult leader's body at absurd speed, like a flamethrower.
"You'll pay for what you did to my father!" she roared, expecting to see Mochen's badly wounded figure.
But that's not what she saw; quite the opposite.

"Oh... I see now... daughter of a tiger, little tigress is... even fiercer than her father, in fact. Hahaha!" Mochen laughed, his eyes settling on Qingyi's rapidly approaching figure, positioning himself next to Biyue.
Qingyi opened his mouth to say something for her, but was interrupted by Mochen.
"I don't have time for small flies, kid. Don't think that defeating my pathetic son gives you the right to challenge me." Mochen punched the air casually. "Get out."
A blast of compressed air left his fists, flowing towards Qingyi's face.
That was an attack strong enough to instantly decapitate any cultivator at the peak of the Renaissance Realm.
But that wasn't what happened to Qingyi.
His head was violently thrown back and the trees still alive beneath his feet swayed wildly with the shockwave.

"Ah..." Qingyi spat out a thin gulp of blood, his eyes now also injected with anger. "Now it's my turn, right? I hope the leader of the demonic cult doesn't have any problems with a few broken teeth."

chapters.title: Chapter 268 - And I thought I was a man blessed by the heavens...
paragraphs: On the horizon, endless ranks of soldiers stretched as far as the eye could see, a cloud of blackened red dust rising as they marched towards the Forest of the Fallen Moon.
suddenly, their march stopped, the eyes of those in the vanguard widening in terror.
The leader of the Demon Cult.
The Celestial Demon.
The most powerful transcendent who had ever set foot on this earth in the last fifty thousand years.
At this very moment, he was lying on the ground, sunk in a smoking crater.
His right hand rose shakily to his face and he spat.
In his bloodied palm, a broken tooth, a subtle pain spreading through his jaw.
His red eyes slowly rose, meeting the icy gaze of a handsome young man.
Mochen and Qingyi had last met a few months ago. Back then, the young man could barely bear a casual movement of the demon cult leader's fingers.
But now... now he possessed enough strength to hurt Mochen. Of course, Mochen had his guard down, not expecting such a strong attack.
Still, he could count on the fingers of a single hand how many transcendents had the ability to hurt him like that in mortal heaven.
"Biyue." Qingyi turned his face, watching his other wives approache.
"You can unleash your anger on the demon army with the others. I promise i'll make him pay for what he did to your father."
Hearing those words, Biyue lowered her head.
Her eyes flicked from the advancing army to the reserve forces, who were desperately trying to reorganize themselves.
"Let's go, Sister Biyue." The poisonous beauty felt Elize's delicate hands grasp hers.
Turning her beautiful face, she saw the excited faces of her sisters, all Qingyi's wives, all eager to finally test the fruit of countless months of cultivation and training.
"Ah..." She sighed, using sound transmission to give some orders to her officers before accompanying the girls.
Their bodies exploded in power as the suppression of their powerful mortal-grade bloodlines fell upon the demonic army.
Biyue, Rongyan and Ruyan took the lead; poison, fire and blood falling on the Crimson Guard.
Hundreds of them, all in the Realm of Rebirth, the pride of the Demon Cult, were ripped to shreds.
Even the weakest of the priestesses could defeat the strongest among them with ease.
"Die, you filthy sluts!" A roar echoed as a man broke through the formation, his Qi exploding violently, making the world around him tremble.
Although Mochen was the only transcendent within the Demon Cult, there were still many other transcendents among the non-orthodox sects who had been forced to join them under threat of annihilation.
This man was one of those transcendents.
His hate-filled eyes focused on Elize, apparently the most delicate of the women. How could she fight efficiently with those massive, heavy things on her chest?
The great axe in his hands glowed with a dark, corrosive Qi. His sclera took on a black hue, red dots glowing in the center of his eyes.
Raising his weapon over his head, he advanced, swinging it towards Elize's delicate, voluptuous figure with all his might.
The purple-haired beauty didn't take a single step back.
Quite the opposite, her body was covered in the lineage projection of an enormous electric dragon, its lightning Qi tearing through the air with a bang.
"Ughn..." She grunted, her sword meeting his axe.
The ground beneath her delicate feet was turned to dust as the shockwave swept everything around.
"'Yield!" The transcendent roared, his powerful muscles burning as he poured all his strength into that attack.
But nothing happened.
Elize stood firm, despite the trembling in her arms.
"I'll help you, sister!" Yueli shouted, passing Elize in a blur, her sword flowing towards the transcendent's unprotected neck.
He despaired, tried to retreat, to activate his most powerful movement technique.
Unfortunately for him, it was too late.
His throat was torn open by the blade of the blue-haired beauty and his axe slipped out of his trembling hands, giving Elize the freedom to pierce his heart.
His mouth opened in a terrified scream, a burst of light leaving his lips as his soul left his body, desperately trying to flee to the skies.
"You're not going anywhere." Yunfei, the girls' master, acted. Her blade sliced the soul through the air, destroying it completely.
Exchanging satisfied glances, they smiled before moving on to their next victim.
In the distance, the leader of the Demon Sect rose from the ground.
His body floated up to the same height as Qingyi, both of them hovering in the sky.
"I have to admit, young man, you've truly surprised me." Mochen laughed, turning his face to watch the one-sided massacre of his army.
"And I thought I was a man blessed by the heavens... With such talent, and with women of such caliber by your side, you are indeed incomparable. Far beyond what the reports I read suggested. Hahaha!"
A moment of silence followed Mochen's laughter. His eyes regained their usual cruelty soon after.
"Even that damned little fox..." He spat, watching that snow-white fox freeze hundreds of his soldiers with a single attack.
From his waist, a crimson saber emerged, glowing menacingly.
"My daughter has never been this talented. And I don't think any of those women are that talented either - not by birth."
Mochen's eyes filtered Qingyi from head to toe. "Someone granted them that power."
He tilted his head, smiling cruelly.
"Tell me, boy. Do I have to cut you open like a frog and rip such a secret out of your guts? or will you obediently hand it over?"
The handsome young man didn't answer immediately. He just shook his head slightly, his face dominated by a soft, confident smile.
The Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword slid out of its sheath with a metallic hiss, pointing straight at Mochen's chest.
"For someone who is about to die..." Qingyi declared arrogantly. "You truly have plenty of time to talk."
"Come on. Show your granddaddy here that you're a filthy cuck less useless than your pathetic son."

chapters.title: Chapter 269 - Boundless audacity
paragraphs: "Cuck? Granddaddy?" Mochen repeated, still unable to comprehend the young man's boundless audacity.
Did Qingyi really believe that, simply because he'd knocked out a tooth, they were on the same level?
Suddenly, Mochen's heart was filled with a hatred so deep that it was no less than what he felt when his best friend perished.

"You're from the Eternal River Sect..." Mochen growled, "Your guardian is that damned tiger, Yanxiao... I fought him a few centuries ago. He barely lasted twenty exchanges before running away with his tail between his legs."
"I wonder... how many can you handle?" The instant Mochen's voice ceased, his saber tore through the air.
A slash of crimson demonic Qi flew towards Qingyi, expanding violently.
The handsome young man didn't dare hold back, not in front of someone like the leader of the Demon Cult.
Gritting his teeth, he summoned the Eternal Wall of the Icy Lord, forming a thick barrier of crystalline ice in front of him.
Mochen's attack landed with a thud, tearing through half the thickness of the wall before finally losing its momentum.
'Now's my chance!' Qingyi repeated in his mind.
His draconic Qi rushed through his meridians, the huge figure of a dragon slowly materializing on his back.
Its thunderous roar echoed through the skies, paralyzing Mochen for a brief instant.
The leader of the Demon Cult retreated slightly, his eyes fixed on the black-scaled, purple-eyed dragon hovering behind Qingyi.
He could feel every hair on his body stand on end. His own bloodline hid in the depths of his gut, trembling at the sight of Qingyi's bloodline.
Was it... afraid of that boy? No... that wasn't possible!
Mochen refused to accept that reality.
His lineage was the lineage of the Celestial Demon, the one destined to be the Emperor of Heaven, to kill the gods themselves!
That was the prophecy of his people, and he would fulfill it.
Qingyi just watched coldly as Mochen activated his own lineage projection.
The image of a huge demon with blood-red eyes and long twisted horns manifested on his back.
His body also began to change, not unlike the transformation his son's body had undergone before being killed by Qingyi.
No. It was even more intense.
His clothes tore. His muscles swelled. Its broken black horns flickered majestically as its body reached more than five meters high, towering above Qingyi.
"I'll rip out your tongue and shove it up your ass!" Mochen roared, attacking again with unbridled fury.
"Oh? Where did you learn such vulgar words? Don't make your granddaddy have to spank you!" Qingyi narrowly dodged Mochen's massive body.
His long black hair fluttered as Mochen's blade passed inches from his face, severing a few strands.
"SILENCE!" Mochen completely lost control, attacking like a crazed beast.
Every movement of his sword sent out waves of Qi that destroyed everything in a radius of hundreds of meters, opening up the earth into deep fissures, causing powerful tremors.
'It's getting dangerous.' Qingyi parried Mochen's sword.
The Lightning Sword's Qi and the demonic Qi collided, the surrounding air boiling. The temperature rose high enough to instantly annihilate anything that dared to approach them.
With a grunt of effort, Qingyi broke away from Mochen.
Activating his Lightning Blink, his body transformed into purple lightning, circling around Mochen.
The leader of the Demon Cult did not allowed himself to be left behind. A scream full of hatred escaped his lips as he transformed into a cloud of demonic Qi.
His movement technique was in no way inferior to Qingyi's in sheer speed.
The speed of both continued to increase, breaking through the sound barrier, becoming nothing but blurs of light before colliding in the center of the battlefield.
A single, short, almost imperceptible flash. But their swords clashed more than fifty times in that instant before they separated, their bodies appearing a few dozen meters apart.
A whole second of absolute stillness followed before the effects of their attacks manifested themselves.
Fifty deafening bangs exploded simultaneously. Trees were uprooted. The ground within a radius of three kilometers turned to dust, creating a massive crater.
Mochen was panting, his eyes bloodshot, a deep gash tearing his chest from side to side.
Qingyi was only a little better, coughing up a gulp of blood, the black dragon scales on his abdomen visibly damaged, crimson liquid dripping down and staining his clothes.
"What? Tired already?" Qingyi teased. "You're not going to let your granddaddy down now, are you?"
He saw the expression on Mochen's face intensify dangerously, his demonic Qi flowing unchecked like an overflowing river.
The Demon Cult leader closed his eyes, trying to control his anger. But a voice he knew very well broke through that attempt.
"Get him, hubby! Blow his balls off just like you did to brother!" Ruyan roared, imbuing Qi into her voice to make sure it reached both of them.
Qingyi only laughed lightly, turning his face towards that naughty little demoness.
Her body was drenched in blood as she killed non-stop.
"Ah..." The leader of the Demon Cult sighed deeply.
His fists closed on the hilt of his sword tighter than ever.
"Do you know what my Law is, brat?" Mochen asked, his voice suddenly calm.
"No, and i don't think it will save your pathetic life." Qingyi spat.
"We'll see." Mochen growled lowly, his eyes filled with a strange energy.
"Get away from him, quickly!" Ruxue shouted in Qingyi's mind
Qingyi's eyes immediately noticed the anomaly and all the girls' protective rings activated at the same time, pulling them into the World of Mind.
No... it wasn't just that.
Qingyi activated his Lightning Blink, moving away from Mochen quickly.
He could see clearly now.
All around Mochen, from the few living plants under his feet to the demon cultivators fighting tens of kilometers away, everything began to wither.
All the vital energy was being violently absorbed by Mochen's body.
The Demon Cult leader readied his blade, retracting it towards his body and aiming it at Qingyi's chest.
His body now glowed with a sickly crimson light, all that stolen vital energy converging on his sword.
"The name of this technique is the Heaven-Piercing Demon Sword." Mochen declared. "Created by our ancestor so that he could defeat the Heavenly Tribulation and ascend to the immortal heavens..."
His red eyes shone with murderous intent.
"Be grateful for having the honor of being killed by it!"

Granddaddy?" Mochen repeated, still unable to comprehend the young man's boundless audacity.

Qingyi stretched out a single hand, opening it gently. His fire Qi exploded into orange flames, forming an ethereal, flaming spear in his grip.
Without hesitation, he hurled it towards Mochen, the surrounding air bursting before forming a perfect vacuum, creating a shockwave that swept away everything in its path.

A second spear appeared in his grip, burning with much more power than the previous one as it was launched towards Mochen.
Again, no visible effect.
This spear was followed by a third. A fourth. And then a fifth spear.
It wasn't until the seventh spear that Qingyi saw Mochen's gaze change.
The energy barrier protecting him trembled, unable to completely absorb the energy of Qingyi's attack.
Instead, it deflected all the power, a sea of fire consuming everything behind it, illuminating the Fallen Moon Forest with a light so intense that the false moon itself darkened in comparison.
"What are you waiting for? Come to your granddaddy!" Qingyi roared, spreading his arms as he summoned the eighth spear, his Qi reserves dropping to less than 50%.
The Art of the Nine Spears of Celestial Fire worked simply.
Nine spears. Each capable of carrying out a single attack. Each attack exponentially more powerful than the last, costing much more Qi.
If the ninth spear wasn't enough, Qingyi would have been in serious trouble.
But he wasn't afraid. Not now.
"You're going to die here, you insolent brat!" Mochen finally attacked, his body moving at a terrifying speed.
All that energy converged at the tip of his sword, the sharp point cutting through the space in front of him, creating powerful fluctuations in the primordial laws around them.
If that attack was sent towards the skies, it would surely be enough on its own to tear a path to the immortal heavens, even without challenging a Tribulation.
How could the eighth spear cope with such absolute power? Its tip shattered on impact with Mochen's attack, all its power dispersing into the surrounding air.
Qingyi gritted his teeth, a thin trickle of blood dripping from his lips.
With a deep sigh, he prepared the ninth and final spear, his meridians burning with the overload of Qi.
This time, he didn't throw it, holding it firmly in his hands and aligning it with Mochen's blade.
The instant their attacks met, there was silence.
For a brief, tenuous moment; silence. Nothing but silence.
And then came the shockwave.
There wasn't a single part of the Fallen Moon Forest that wasn't affected. Earthquakes erupted even kilometers away, the world split between Mochen's demonic Qi and Qingyi's fire Qi.
Their eyes met, full of ferocity and rage. The demon and the black dragon of their bloodlines roared at each other, their auras colliding.
Mochen kept pushing, a confident smile dominating his monstrous face.
He was afraid that Qingyi would try to dodge the direct confrontation. But fortunately, Qingyi decided to face him head-on.
There was no way that the Heaven Piercing Demon Sword would lose in a direct battle!
Or so he thought.
It wasn't long before Mochen realized something: Qingyi wasn't giving in.
No matter how much force he put into it. No matter how much his sword shimmered with that sickly demonic Qi.

Preparing himself, Qingyi also gave a final thrust.
A sharp metallic clang echoed as the spear shattered Mochen's sword into hundreds of crimson fragments.

Soon, all of Qingyi's other wives appeared, hugging him tightly and tending to his wounds.

At that very moment, an explosion of mana was occurring on the horizon, coming from a place Qingyi knew well: the Eternal River Sect, the place where its sect leader had been put under house arrest by Yanxiao.

chapters.title: Chapter 272 - A traitor to the orthodox way
paragraphs: "Don't let him move!" The leader of the divine sword sect roared, his eyes glowing with a golden light, just like his sword.
In front of him, the colossal figure of the false demonic dragon, the only demonic beast left, its scales twisted and covered in horrible wounds.
A spear was plunged into its chest while a sea of ice surrounded it, trapping it in place.
After another moment of preparation, the leader of the divine sword sect attacked.
His sword tore through the air with all the power of an expert at the peak of the transcendence realm, a golden trail accompanying his movement towards the dragon's enormous neck.
The beast roared, its demonic Qi leaking out, its blood-red eyes filled with pain and despair.
"Die!" One last scream was all it heard before the attack tore through it's scales, flesh and bones, its pupils losing their light as its decapitated head fell to the ground.
"Shit..." Yanxiao spat, his body shrinking to its usual size, smaller but still imposing.
His eyes swept over all the survivors.

Among the patriarchs, leaders and guardians of the nine great sects and seven great families, there were a total of 21 transcendents, excluding the deceased Tang patriarch and the currently imprisoned leader of the Eternal River Sect.
All of these 21 transcendents had given their vow to fight against the demon cult, the vow to die for the orthodox way.
Of course, none of them actually planned to fulfill the last part of this vow. Even so, there were only 12 transcendents standing there.
The leader of the ancestral dragon sect.
The leader of the Ice Flower Sect.
The leader of the Eternal Heaven Sect.
The leader of the Divine sword sect.
The leader of the Hidden Moon Sect.
The guardian of the Ice Flower Sect.
The guardian of the Eternal River Sect.
The guardian of the divine sword sect.
The patriarchs of the Li, Zhao, Xu and Bai families.
Five of the leaders of the nine great sects, four of the patriarchs of the seven great families and three of the guardians.
All the others had died, their souls able to last only a few minutes outside their destroyed bodies before finally dissipating.
"How long has it been since we had such horrific losses?" The icy tigress approached the flaming tiger, her eyes full of grief.
Behind them, eighty percent of the Orthodox army had also been wiped out and the rest soon began to clear the battlefield.

"It's not over yet... That damned Xue Mochen, how dare he use such tactics against us?" The flaming tiger snarled, his feral face filled with rage as he turned to the leader of the ancestral dragon sect, who had just retrieved his spear.
"Long Baiyu, activate the teleportation arrays, we need to go to the reserve army now!"

"And do what there?" The leader of the ancestral dragon sect spat on the ground, his handsome face now marked by a horrible scar. "Die for nothing? Surrender? Look at our state, we have no way of defeating Mochen! Not in our current condition."
"Oh?" Yanxiao frowned, "The mighty Long Baiyu is afraid of a shitty little demon? I'll burn my life essence if necessary, but that bastard dies today!"

"It's not about cowardice, it's about survival. We need to return to the orthodox alliance, recover and take a defensive position. Only the arrays of our sects are enough to hold him off!" Baiyu also losing started control of his emotions.
Yanxiao was about to reply when a voice called out to him, one of the Eternal River Sect elders who was loyal to him.
"Guardian!" The elder bowed, bringing with him a chubby man. "This young man is Heidu, he-"
"I don't care," Yanxiao grunted angrily, "get him out of my sight."
The old man shuddered, gritting his teeth.
Yanxiao had been temperamental since the sect leader's house arrest, but now he seemed to be even worse than before.

Gathering his courage, he spoke: "He was Qingyi's companion in the snake battalion, taking part in the espionage mission in the demon cult and personally witnessing the battle between Qingyi and the cult's heir. He claims to have information proving that Qingyi is a traitor to the orthodox way!"
Those words paralyzed all the transcendents there.
Qingyi... a traitor?
"Are you sure of this information?" Yanxiao turned his face slowly, staring at Heidu.
"Yes, guardian." The chubby man spoke, his knees buckling under the pressure.

"Well, if you're telling the truth, I'll reward you well, but if you're lying, pray for a quick death." Yanxiao spoke, ignoring Heidu's shudder and focusing his gaze on the leader of the divine sword sect.
"Use the mirror of a thousand truths on him."
Hearing those words, the divine sword sect leader let out a dissatisfied grunt.

The mirror of a thousand truths was one of his sect's artifacts, capable of discerning truth from lies perfectly. Who the hell did Yanxiao think he was to order him to use his sect's artifact like that?
Despite being irritated, the leader of the Divine Sword Sect still gave in. A matter of such gravity concerned the entire orthodox world.
Waving, a small golden mirror appeared in his hands and he pointed it at Heidu.
"Give your testimony young man, the mirror will react to the lie," he ordered.
Heidu calmed his breathing before puffing out his chest.

"I, Heidu, a former member of the snake battalion of the orthodox alliance, saw with my own eyes Qingyi defeat the heir of the demon cult, using a strange artifact to summon a woman to his side right after the battle."
Receiving confused looks from the transcendents, he continued.
"That woman is Xue Ruyan, daughter of the demon lord. Not only did Qingyi have her by his side, but he even kissed her! Qingyi has a demon as a lover!"
The moment those words rang out, the strangeness on the transcendentes faces turned in to a deep shock.
Long Qingyi, with a demon?
The rumors of him being with Tang Biyue were already absurd, but nothing compared to what they had just heard there.
Having any kind of relationship with a demonic cultivator was a crime punishable by death!
Yanxiao turned his face, looking at the mirror in the hands of the divine sword sect leader.
No reaction. That meant Heidu was telling the truth.
Yanxiao's lips opened, preparing to speak, but a commotion interrupted him, again.
The demonic Qi around them, which had previously been out of control, suddenly calmed down completely, the fluctuations caused by the demonic amy movements disappearing.

chapters.title: Chapter 273 - I want to be by your side
paragraphs: "The leader of the demonic cult is dead..." A voice echoed among the transcendents.
The formations that the demonic sect used to cause chaos in the demonic Qi of the deadlands could only be activated and maintained by the cult leader himself.
They were sure that he wouldn't deactivate them, not before dealing the final blow to the orthodox alliance. So there was only one possibility: Xue Mochen was dead.
"We need to get to the reserve army now!" Yanxiao roared and the teleportation artifact they had prepared glowed with an intense golden light.
Before they were teleported, Yanxiao used his Qi to grab the chubby man. "You're coming with us."
The moment Yanxiao's voice fell silent, the bodies of the twelve transcendents and Heidu disappeared.
The space around them shook violently before revealing the forest of the fallen moon, which now could no longer bear that name.
The fragments of its fake moon were scattered on the ground, as was one of the Tang family's arks, cut in half.
The entire surrounding terrain had been swept clean of any life, taken over by ashes, craters and melted glass.
The flaming tiger sniffed the air, sensing the remaining demonic Qi.
"That bastard really is dead... hahaha!" The patriarch of the Zhao family laughed, but none of the other transcendents showed the same happiness.
"Qingyi isn't here, nor is Biyue, nor is the reserve army..." The leader of the Ice Flower Sect spoke, studying the battlefield.
Where could they have gone? Perhaps they had gone to meet up with the main army? It was possible.
Thousands of possibilities took over the minds of everyone there, until something finally popped into Yanxiao's mind.
Qingyi had the same scent as the leader of the Eternal River Sect or, to be more specific, the scent of the immortal being who had stolen her body.
Before, Qingyi could do nothing but lower his head, but now, he had the power to question Yanxiao, to fight him. Had he finally revealed his true colors?
"He's in my sect," Yanxiao declared and, ignoring the stares of everyone there, shot into the sky.
The damned immortal who had taken his best friend away from him! Who had taken that smiling little girl away from him!
Qingyi was truly linked to that damned immortal, he was sure of it now.
"Wait!" The other transcendents tried to stop Yanxiao, but without receiving any response from him, they could only follow right behind.
Unaware of what was happening between the transcendents of the orthodox alliance, Qingyi sat cross-legged on Khaedryss' back.
With his eyes closed, he felt Ruxue's caresses, his head using her huge boobs as a pillow.
"Do you think this could come from Elize's sister?" Ruxue asked.
She had heard the conversation between Qingyi and Yanxiao. From the way Khaedryss was acting, it was hard to think of any other alternative.
"I don't know... I don't even know if the immortal who supposedly took over the sect leader's body is someone who wants Elize's good," Qingyi replied.
Apart from Yanxiao's claims about smelling something similar to the sect leader's on him, a type that only comes from blood connection, he really didn't know much.
The only reason he came up with the possibility of that person being Elize's sister was because of the few memories Elize still had from when she was a child: her sister, her mother and Khaedryss.
Those were the most important people to Elize, the only ones she still had in her memory from her childhood and the most likely to have gone after her.
After a moment's hesitation, Qingyi called out to Elize, pulling her onto his lap.
"Husband? Are you all right? Why is little purple one so agitated?" The purple-haired beauty asked, gently touching Qingyi's face.

"Something is happening in the Eternal River Sect, something big... I believe it may have something to do with the person who brought Khaedryss into this world." Qingyi replied, placing his large, rough and powerful hands on Elize's small, soft and delicate ones.
Elize shuddered at those words. Her eyes widened as her heart raced, her mind seized by a whirlwind of possibilities.
Was it her sister? Her mother? Someone trying to hurt her?
She lowered her head, hugging Qingyi, her face sunk into his broad chest. "Do you think it could be my sister? Or my mother?" Elize asked anxiously.
"I don't know darling... I really don't know." Qingyi shook his head. He didn't want to give Elize any false hope.
"I... I understand..." Elize bit her lower lips, her eyes watering as she shifted focus, touching the black scales on Khaedryss' neck.
The dragon turned her face gently, watching Elize with a deep gaze.
"It must be someone important... someone good..." Elize whispered. "Little Purple would never take me to someone who wanted to hurt me. I know that."
Turning to Qingyi, she hugged him again.
"Do you want to go back to the world of the mind with the others? You need to rest." Qingyi spoke, his hands running through Elize's long, silky hair.
"N-no," she said, her voice trembling as her face filled with determination.
"I want to be by your side when you find this person."
The moment Elize's words fell, she pressed her plump, juicy lips against Qingyi's, her huge tits squeezed against his chest.
After a moment like that, they separated and Qingyi hurried Khaedryss into flying even faster.
The journey from there to the Orthodox sect would normally take weeks, but Khaedryss flew faster than ever, rushing it by a wide margin.
The intensity of the mana leaking over the horizon growing even stronger, powerful pulses spreading for thousands of kilometers.
Whatever was happening there, it was a level of power beyond anything Qingyi had ever seen in his entire life.
After just three days of travel, Qingyi finally saw the Eternal River Sect, his eyes widening as he felt Khaedryss become even more agitated.
Whoever that person was, the heavens certainly weren't happy with her.
What do you guys think of the pacing so far? Is it too rushed? I made the decision to speed up the pace, but I'm afraid I've rushed it too much.
